case: Current two-product sales / returns / warranty case, 2011–2020

formula_port.monthly_revenue: SUMIF over product revenue and continuous year-month index
formula_port.clearance: monthly price below 120-month mean, recurring month
formula_port.return_rate: claims booked at t+1 / units sold at t
formula_port.warranty_rate: claims booked at t+2 / units sold at t

compatibility: Extract saved/displayed answers, strip currency separators, strip percent signs as in script 6, lowercase month strings, round numbers to one decimal with ties-to-even as in script 8. Because the source pipeline exports formatted CSV, percentage versus decimal formatting can change the legacy result. Legacy mode preserves that behavior for comparison.
concept_policy: Normalize 8.38% and 0.0838 identically; absolute tolerance 0.05 dollars for totals/prices and 0.00005 for rates (0.005 percentage points). Require full English month names, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace.
adaptations: Ten designated Solution answer cells only; answers elsewhere do not earn credit
Unsupported file formats, disguised OOXML files, altered case layout, missing metadata or missing protection are rejected with zero
Required generated sheets include both protected source copies; no editable-source fallback for submissions
Frozen Solution!B4 timestamp must be present, plausible, and locked on a protected Solution sheet
Identity fields B1:B3 are required for structural validation; never sent to the LLM
Formula without cached value receives zero until recalculated and saved; marked unavailable rather than diagnosed
No VBA, arbitrary formula evaluation, OCR, screenshot grading, image assessment, COM automation or CSV intermediates
prototype_points: One point per technical answer, ten points total. These display weights are a prototype choice; the legacy script exports correctness flags rather than a published ten-point rubric.
wrong_answer_models_source: original common-mistake grading materials / Autograding Program - Deliverables / Deliverables / 2B. Sales Simulation Project - Additional function to grade common mistake / Solution file / solution_template.xlsm, plus explicitly identified prototype extensions. Numerical matches are hypotheses, not proof of a student's method.
engine: Python 3 via Pyodide 0.27.7 in a browser Web Worker; no JavaScript answer scoring
visual_assessment: Excluded. No report, graph, image, chart or professional-judgment points.

integrity_limits.seed: The supplied macro does not store a reproducible random seed; no seed verification claim is made.
integrity_limits.timestamp: Presence, parseability, plausibility and cell/sheet protection are checked; these do not cryptographically authenticate generation time.
integrity_limits.fingerprint: SHA-256 over original daily source values and monthly claims; an identifier, not a reproducible seed.
integrity_limits.duplicates: A stateless single-file checker cannot compare against other students without trusted cohort records.
integrity_limits.authenticity: Excel sheet protection is a workflow check, not proof that protected values are authentic.
